claims.statement: ./script/test-dsp.sh is the canonical DSP test loop: it configures the build directory if needed, builds --target DspTests, and execs the DspTests binary with any optional gtest filter. The binary can also be run directly by hand: cmake --build build --target DspTests, then the binary in build/test/DspTests_artefacts (also registered with ctest).

The fixture set in test/files/ ships the ground truth: NAM A2 captures (a2-am-test-2.nam, a2-amp-test.nam, a2-amp-cab-test.nam), cabinet IRs (cab-ir-test.wav, cab-ir-test-2.wav), reverb IRs (reverb-ir-mono-test.wav, reverb-ir-stereo-test.wav), and em240-gold-plate-5s.wav, the EMT 240 plate reference used by the plate-mode law tests.

DspTests compiles the real StandaloneStateAutosave portable no-op stub (not the iOS-only .mm observer) because Processor.cpp's constructor calls StandaloneStateAutosave::install(); this suite never runs where the real observer would be compiled.

The plate guard suite lives in three registered test files in test/CMakeLists.txt: src/plate_comb_tests.cpp, src/plate_family_tests.cpp (P1 EMT140 family table, P2 cross-model, P4 knob laws incl. SizeLaw, P5 stereo image, P6 cap/CPU; baselines re-pinned 2026-10-16 by the P2.1 density uplift: level-law baseline 93.95 @2000 ms, comb cap 21.98 @2500 ms), and src/plate_texture_tests.cpp (baselines re-pinned 2026-10-16: level 93.95 (was 78.23 pre-uplift), comb kModelComb 19.39 @2000 ms retained as the final-pass anchor).

The R1 reverb Dry anchor test TEST(ProcessorTest, ReverbDryScalesOnlyTheDryPathAllModes) (test/src/processor_tests.cpp, ~822, added alongside the convolver analogue) loops all 6 reverb modes; at mix=0 it asserts a -6 dB Dry setting scales the dry term by exactly gain(-6 dB); at mix=1 it asserts the wet (reverb tail) output is invariant under the Dry knob. It runs in ~460 ms and passes.

The P2 probe suites added by the 2026-10-16 reverb-budget-quality-uplift pass are registered in test/CMakeLists.txt (src/reverb_probe_tmp.cpp Plate Probe suite W1 lift sweep ship 1.15, src/room_probe_tmp.cpp Room Probe suite W2 wash norm 1.20, src/chamber_probe_tmp.cpp Chamber Probe suite W2 washFrac 1.60 + 8.0 kHz cap sweep 12000->8000 Hz). They compile the real plugin sources and guard the shipped constant values so a regression in the plate lift, room wash normalization, or chamber wash fraction fails the suite.

The T-DAT-001 plate-DAT rebuild added the standing DatGuards suite in test/src/dat_probe_tests.cpp, registered in test/CMakeLists.txt: StableAcrossSizeDecayGrid, LongerDecayKeepsTheLongTail, LoCutDropsTheLowBand (stable one-pole HPF x LPF band meter), AirLiftsTheTopBand, WidthWidensThePlateImage (width-gated M/S side gain), ModZeroIsBitPass and ModOneAudiblyChangesTheRender (both pinned to the sharedMod gate field after the wave-3 Mod rebind to the post-wet shared-chorus layer), with DatGuards.* running 8 tests total. Legacy-plate color/dwell guards re-pinned to the mode 5 / type[5]==2 arm via helpers in test/src/plate_family_tests.cpp (plateLegacyP/plateLegacyAt) and test/src/plate_texture_tests.cpp (plateLegacy Defaults/plateLegacyDecay). The interim diagnostic suites (dat_exp, goldengrid, loopsolo, loopgain, arb, rerun, boundary2, margin, finallaw, sitekill, s_datDecDrive scaffolding) were removed at closeout.

DspTests is a JUCE console app (juce_add_console_app) whose target_sources list compiles the real plugin sources straight from the plugin tree so the tests exercise the real processor, not a copy. After the repo-organization reorg the fork-only effect engines are listed from their new subdirectories: ../plugin/src/effects/conv/ConvolutionReverb.cpp, ../plugin/src/effects/conv/BudgetConvolver.cpp, ../plugin/src/effects/chorus/Chorus.cpp, ../plugin/src/effects/delay/Delay.cpp, plus the upstream-owned flat plugin/src files (AutoOffset.cpp, BlockEq.cpp, BlockSpectrum.cpp, LegacyParamIds.cpp, MidiMapper.cpp, NamEngine.cpp, PresetFile.cpp, PresetManager.cpp, Processor.cpp, ProcessorChain.cpp, ProcessorHistory.cpp, ProcessorModelLoader.cpp, ProcessorPresets.cpp, ProcessorState.cpp, Spread.cpp, StandaloneStateAutosave.cpp, PitchShift.cpp, StereoOffset.cpp, TunerDetector.cpp).

The DspTests suite grows with features (a count here is a lower-bound snapshot, never assert a stale total on a red run): 487 after the R2 thirteenth/final cut (2026-10-15, commit 1aa620e), 493 after the P2.1 plate density uplift (2026-10-16), 503 after the reverb-budget-quality-uplift pass (P0 ceiling pin test/src/reverb_ceiling_p0_tests.cpp suite ReverbCeiling; P1 per-mode table test/src/reverb_quality_p1_tests.cpp; probe suites test/src/reverb_probe_tmp.cpp, room_probe_tmp.cpp, chamber_probe_tmp.cpp), and 511 after the T-DAT-001 plate-DAT wave-3 closeout (2026-10-17, commit 1d069c9) — still 511 across the repo-organization reorg (commits bc19343..1bcaf32, pure file moves: DspTests 511/511 on every gate). The R2 measurement infrastructure is standing in test/src/effect_tests.cpp; the full legacy-plate law guard suite remains anchored at the Digital/PLT entry (mode 5, type[5]==2).

The swappable-theme ticket (2026-10-14) added src/theme_palette_tests.cpp to the DspTests target_sources, which compiles the real plugin/ui/core/Theme.h inline palette globals (ThemePalette / applyPalette / resetPalette / ocrPalette) and asserts the default palette round-trips, so the UI colour tokens are exercised by the headless suite without pulling in any other UI source beyond the existing Labels.cpp.

DspTests pulls exactly FOUR UI files from the plugin tree: plugin/ui/core/Labels.cpp (the KnobScale readout formatter the scale-contract tests link), plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.cpp (the node grid's read-side model) + plugin/ui/model/ChainState.cpp (NodeModel's data source, added by the 2026-10-18 node-view closeout), and plugin/ui/views/gallery/EffectParams.cpp (the shared paramsFor knob table, added by the node-view batch-2 closeout for the per-knob strip readout tests); the include path adds plugin/ui and plugin/ui/views/nodeview on top of plugin/ui/core. A green DspTests run still does not prove the full UI links — views, widgets, and services remain excluded.

The node-view closeout (2026-10-18, commit 9201777) added src/node_model_tests.cpp — 9 NodeModel tests covering the kind table, paletteKinds, blockAt/indexOf, and the orderWith erase+insert splice used by grid drag-and-drop (permutation invariance, exact-slot move, same-slot no-op, unknown-id untouched, target clamping, empty-square move) — bringing the suite to 521 tests. The count is a lower-bound snapshot; never assert a stale total on a red run.

test/src/strip_knob_tests.cpp registers three suites: 7 StripKnob tests (every paramsFor knob of Delay/Chorus/Tremolo/Compressor vca+clip/Reverb (all 6 modes)/Convolution/Tone round-trips through knobFromStored/knobToStored in [0,1] and formats to a finite readout; numeric readouts are capped at 4 chars so INT64-scale garbage fails), 8 StripKnobPosition tests (identity-scale knobs report pos == raw 0..1, including the In/Out gain knobs pinned to noon, plus stored→raw round-trips through the strip's position mapping, added in the node-view batch-3 closeout commit 5b9bdd9), and — added in the 2026-10-17 bug-batch closeout (commits 0cb035e–22bbaf6) — 6 StripGalleryParity tests (the strip's visible knob set equals the gallery's signature+full knob set in BOTH directions: strip ⊆ gallery and gallery ⊆ strip for every kind/mode, plus a ≤12 knob-count cap matching kMaxKnobs). test/src/add_at_slot_tests.cpp registers 2 AddAtSlot tests (landToneBlock fills a mid-lane gap in place and a trailing insert at the end; the mid-lane test also asserts a removed effect's blockId is gone while the gap persists, exercising removeChainBlock's fresh-INSERT-at-erased-position behavior). test/CMakeLists.txt also compiles ../plugin/ui/views/gallery/EffectParams.cpp (the per-kind knob table the strip and EffectTile share) for the strip tests. Suite total after the 2026-10-17 bug-batch closeout: 548 tests from 79 suites (538/79 was the batch-3 closeout; 530/78 was the 2026-10-16 batch-2 closeout) — the count is a lower-bound snapshot; never assert a stale total on a red run.
